transport: HTTP-01 POST / response body (JSON-serialized signed Nostr event); future transports per NOSTR-01

device-identifier.value: hardware identifier of the customer's device; the reference uses type 'mac' and a colon-hex MAC

start-time.value: session start; emitted by the reference implementation on fresh sessions (additive; the renewal variant omits it)

p.rule: present ONLY when the payment carried a customer Nostr identity. Raw bearer-token payments (the normative path since March 2026) carry none — such sessions omit p and are identified by device-identifier alone. When present, p MUST be a Nostr pubkey (64 hex chars): never a device identifier, MAC address, or any other value.
